stop: Stop when both arms' 1000 C-MERGE pairs are scored (40 units each) or the owner cap is reached. Nobody opens labels before 2026-11-26 01:45Z.
_doc: Role stress, lineage cfcap-stress. Task stress_merge (cfcap/t2/merge_task.py) with --task-spec. Margins are applied by scripts/stress_conf_merge.py from the frozen exploratory results/stress/N4_margins.json (q_cf from E2's exploratory pairs, q_pert_by_nmod from E2's T1 perturbations), which must be committed before any confirmatory unit is read. Shard 0 = an exploratory spare (pairs 100000+, root 92599/99).
